name: acme-retrieval-v1
description: Questions an on-call engineer would ask during the seeded payment-service incident. Expected documents are the ones a competent responder would want; retrieval is scored on whether it surfaces them.

cases.question: What is the rollback procedure for payment-service?
cases.expected_answer: Identify the current and previous release, announce in the incident channel, run the rollback command, then watch the error rate for five minutes.

cases.question: Has payment-service had a connection pool problem before?
expected_documents: Postmortem: INC-88 payment-service connection pool exhaustion
cases.expected_answer: Yes — INC-88, where a deploy reduced the per-pod pool and requests timed out acquiring connections at peak.

cases.question: How should the payment-service connection pool be sized?
cases.expected_answer: Total connections are pods multiplied by pool size and must stay below max_connections with headroom; pools below 10 per pod have caused acquisition timeouts at peak.

cases.question: Which runbook covers Redis session store failures?
cases.expected_answer: The auth-service session store failover runbook: confirm the primary is down, promote the replica, and never flush the store.

cases.question: What should I check first when a service starts returning 5xx?
cases.expected_answer: Whether anything shipped recently, what the dominant error message is, which metric moved first, and whether dependencies are healthy — mitigate before diagnosing.

cases.question: Can I run a database migration to fix a live incident?
expected_documents: Runbook: database migrations during an incident
cases.expected_answer: Only if it is the only mitigation and the database on-call agrees; a rollback does not revert migrations.

cases.question: Why did notifications get delayed after the batching change?
cases.expected_answer: Batch size was tuned for throughput without checking the slowest consumer, so the queue grew faster than it drained.

cases.question: What does 'timeout acquiring connection from pool' mean?
expected_documents: Postmortem: INC-88 payment-service connection pool exhaustion
cases.expected_answer: Requests queued for a database connection and exceeded the acquisition timeout, usually because the pool is too small for peak concurrency.
